who: GPT-6 Astra Pro, scheduler correctness review lane
what: Execution::work_call updated the helper liveness table before accepting the request. WorkSet's three entry-invalidation branches matched Exported and omitted the equivalent FromStore outcome.
cost: Refused work traffic could refresh a helper's lead-replacement priority. The generic discovery protocol failed to emit an invalidation for a cached entry rejected by the lead or invalidated by a name conflict.
cause: A side effect preceded the acceptance boundary, and admission rules classified reusable entries by how their bytes were obtained.
whys: An invalid work request changed the recent-contact table despite returning a refusal.
The execution wrapper recorded contact before the work set checked the request.
Tests distinguished assigned and heartbeating helpers but did not exercise refused work traffic.
Name invalidation matched only the newly compiled outcome; cached results lacked equivalent causal controls.
class: work authority changes outside the acceptance decision that justifies it
prevention: Only successful work calls update helper contact. All existing entry-invalidation branches match both reusable entry outcomes. Tape-driven controls cover refused-message ordering, stale liveness and cached entries before and after conflicts or lead rejection.
fix: Implemented acceptance-ordered liveness and invalidation symmetry. Added controls that restore premature liveness or drop an invalidation; the cached ordering cases are mandatory reach points.
state: Implemented; exact-tree native validation is pending with the main lane. No production importer failure or build-speed improvement is claimed for the generic name-invalidation path.
